edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the underlying dispute between them (the “Dispute”).
edits.name: Scope of settlement

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff $10,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) within 30 days after both parties execute this Agreement.
edits.name: Settlement payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or obligations under this Agreement. Promptly following receipt of the Settlement Amount in full in cleared funds, the parties shall take all steps necessary to dismiss the pending action concerning the Dispute with prejudice.
edits.name: Limited release and conditional dismissal

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that disclosures may be made to that party’s legal and tax advisers, as required by law, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Each party shall instruct its advisers receiving such information to maintain its confidentiality.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions

edits.text: 5. FEES AND COSTS. Each party shall bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in connection with the Dispute and the negotiation and execution of this Agreement.
edits.name: Own fees and costs
